title: Wendell and the Static
author: Kestrel Delacroix
blurb: Casper Dunmore, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
